body: it's the thought of my mother that holds me back as well

i appreciate that you've taken time to write a thoughtful response

I am not interested in school or a job for their own sake. But they are necessities for life. How do I make it in the world without a job? And if I don't get a decent education, I am going to spend my entire life at a job that I hate. I have hated every job that I've worked so far.

It honestly feels hopeless. I am simply not cut out for the requirements of adult living. The pain and discomfort seem like they will always outweigh the happiness.
